scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the dishwasher warranty inspection on a no-charge weekend route after the live water test becomes impossible.
Emerging Need: The video inspection is underway when a building supply interruption prevents the required flow test.
Decision Context: Retrieve the registered appliance and existing-claim route, then prepare a free switch to the offered in-person visit during the owner's confirmed availability. No serial mismatch or disabled upload is involved.
Consequence: After the offered Sunday slot is assigned elsewhere, this weekend alternative is lost; the claim can continue later.

parameter.title: AquaHome dishwasher video inspection window
parameter.description: Warranty video room for countertop dishwasher leak review. Nicolette is also home Sunday 09:00-noon and permits a no-charge existing-claim inspection in that window if today's room cannot finish; paid visits require a separate decision.
Temporary verification hold for countertop dishwasher warranty video room AH620.

parameter.subject: Video inspection room AH620 is open
parameter.body: AH620 is active. The warranty record and leak photos are accepted; the technician has begun the live flow-test step. Keep the unit off until the technician confirms supply is usable.

parameter.content: The building water supply stopped during the live inspection. The building desk says the emergency shutoff will last until this evening. The technician cannot run the flow test, so I switched the dishwasher off and paused the inspection.

parameter.subject: AH620 no-charge Sunday inspection alternative
parameter.body: With the flow test unavailable today, the same existing claim can use a free in-person inspection Sunday 09:00-10:00 after supply returns. Send the registered serial and retained receipt label through the usual warranty desk by 10:25 to accept that window. No plan purchase or expedited fee is required; otherwise the Sunday slot returns to the queue.

parameter.subject: Sunday alternative for AH620 released
parameter.body: The offered no-charge Sunday 09:00 inspection was not accepted before 10:25 and has been assigned elsewhere. AH620 remains an existing claim, but the next ordinary inspection is after this weekend; no paid visit has been authorized.
